newsitem.title: USA: Jack Henry votes 50 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Jack Henry votes 50 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Jack Henry & Associates Inc said Monday its board of directors declared a 50 percent stock dividend on its common stock, payable March 13 to stockholders of record at the close of business on February 24.
The stock dividend is effectively a three-for-two split, it aqdded.
Total shares outstanding will be about 18 million and the public float will exceed 10.8 million shares, it added. At January 31, 1997, 11,960,566 shares of the common stock were outstanding.
Jack Henry provides integrated computer systems and ATM networking products for banks and other financial institutions.
